WITH tied AS (
    SELECT session, stamp, COUNT(*) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT path) AS path_count
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
    GROUP BY session, stamp
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 'activity_log action/path' AS diagnostic, action AS value1, path AS value2, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM main.activity_log
GROUP BY action, path
UNION ALL
SELECT 'tied view timestamps', CAST(event_count AS TEXT), CAST(path_count AS TEXT), COUNT(*)
FROM tied
GROUP BY event_count, path_count
UNION ALL
SELECT 'access_log page source', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM main.access_log
WHERE stamp = '/detail' OR action = '/detail'
ORDER BY diagnostic, n DESC
LIMIT 60

arguments.sql:
WITH views AS (
    SELECT session, stamp, path,
           LAG(path) OVER chronological AS previous_path,
           LAG(path, 2) OVER chronological AS second_previous_path,
           LAG(stamp, 2) OVER chronological AS second_previous_stamp,
           LAG(path) OVER reverse_ties AS reverse_previous_path,
           LAG(path, 2) OVER reverse_ties AS reverse_second_previous_path
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
    WINDOW chronological AS (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid),
           reverse_ties AS (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid DESC)
)
SELECT 'log row order' AS ordering, path, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM views
WHERE previous_path = '/detail' AND second_previous_path = '/detail'
GROUP BY path
UNION ALL
SELECT 'reverse ties', path, COUNT(*)
FROM views
WHERE reverse_previous_path = '/detail' AND reverse_second_previous_path = '/detail'
GROUP BY path
UNION ALL
SELECT 'distinct stamps at endpoints', path, COUNT(*)
FROM views
WHERE previous_path = '/detail' AND second_previous_path = '/detail' AND stamp <> second_previous_stamp
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY ordering, n DESC, path

    SELECT
        path AS third_page,
        LAG(path, 1) OVER visit_order AS previous_page,
        LAG(path, 2) OVER visit_order AS second_previous_page
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
    WINDOW visit_order AS (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid)
)
SELECT third_page, COUNT(*) AS visit_count
FROM page_visits
WHERE previous_page = '/detail'
  AND second_previous_page = '/detail'
GROUP BY third_page
ORDER BY visit_count DESC, third_page DESC
LIMIT 3
